items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Joyce Wein was one of the recipients and -- I forgot who else. Anyway, they were -- they had booked the room ... for this to be a whole week of jazz for women.

ctx.x: Yes. Mary Lou and myself and some other women in jazz -- not necessarily performers.
Joyce Wein was one of the recipients and -- I forgot who else.
